ex.en: My automatic response was to say sorry, even though I had done nothing wrong.
ex.zh: 我下意识地说了声抱歉，尽管我并没有做错。

words.note: automatic 还指无意识的本能反应；副词是 automatically。

ex.en: Despite the heavy rain, the match went on as planned.
ex.zh: 尽管下着大雨，比赛仍按计划进行。

words.note: despite 是介词，接句子要用 despite the fact that。

ex.en: Prices have risen for three consecutive years, worrying many families.
ex.zh: 物价连续三年上涨，令许多家庭担忧。

words.note: consecutive 只作定语；口语连续几天说 in a row。

ex.en: The police have launched a probe into how the documents were leaked.
ex.zh: 警方已就文件如何泄露展开调查。

words.note: probe into 指深入调查；probe 也指探测器。

ex.en: The assimilation of new arrivals takes time and often meets resistance.
ex.zh: 新来者的同化需要时间，且常遇阻力。

words.note: assimilate 是动词；assimilation 也指知识的吸收。

ex.en: He groaned with pain as the nurse cleaned the wound.
ex.zh: 护士清洗伤口时，他痛得呻吟起来。

words.note: groan 指低沉呻吟，多因痛苦；moan 语气更弱。

ex.en: The town grew quickly during the industrial boom of the 1950s.
ex.zh: 在二十世纪五十年代的工业繁荣中，这座城镇迅速发展。

words.note: industrial 指工业的；industrious 指人勤勉，勿混。

ex.en: The students conducted a survey on how people spend their weekends.
ex.zh: 学生们就人们如何过周末做了一项调查。

words.note: 名词重音在前，动词在后；conduct a survey 是常用搭配。

ex.en: The actress wore a deep blue velvet dress to the ceremony.
ex.zh: 那位女演员穿着深蓝色天鹅绒长裙出席典礼。

words.note: velvet 不可数，作定语直接修饰名词，如 velvet dress。

ex.en: The study combines quantitative data with interviews of local farmers.
ex.zh: 这项研究把定量数据与对当地农民的访谈结合起来。

words.note: quantitative 指定量，qualitative 指定性，成对记忆。

ex.en: The patient's condition has remained stable since the operation.
ex.zh: 手术后病人的病情一直保持稳定。

words.note: stable 作形容词指稳定，作名词指马厩；名词 stability。

ex.en: The family reunion brought together relatives who had not met for years.
ex.zh: 家庭团聚让多年未见的亲戚聚在一起。

words.note: re- 表「再」+ union 表「联合」，故为团聚。

ex.en: You look fantastic in that jacket, and the colour suits you.
ex.zh: 你穿那件夹克真好看，颜色也很适合你。

words.note: fantastic 口语常表极好；也可指荒诞不实的。

ex.en: Heavy rain flooded the streets because the drainage system was blocked.
ex.zh: 大雨淹了街道，因为排水系统堵塞了。

words.note: drain 是动词排水，drainage 是名词，指排水系统。

ex.en: The company responded to the complaints by changing its refund policy.
ex.zh: 公司通过修改退款政策来回应这些投诉。

words.note: respond 不及物，接宾语用 respond to；名词 response。

ex.en: The flight landed safely, and the whole trip passed without incident.
ex.zh: 航班安全降落，整个旅程平安无事。

words.note: incident 指偶发事件，多不愉快；accident 指意外。

ex.en: He gave a lame excuse for missing the deadline again.
ex.zh: 他又一次错过了截止日期，还给了个站不住脚的借口。

words.note: lame 本义瘸的，引申指借口理由站不住脚。

ex.en: She soaked in a hot tub after the long hike.
ex.zh: 长途徒步后，她泡了个热水浴缸。

words.note: tub 指桶、盆或浴缸；a tub of 可作量词。

ex.en: A cluster of small shops has grown up around the new station.
ex.zh: 新车站周围开起了一小片商店。

words.note: cluster 指同类事物聚成一簇，动词常接 around。

ex.en: Elderly people often fall prey to telephone scams.
ex.zh: 老年人常常成为电话诈骗的受害者。

words.note: fall prey to 中 prey 前不加冠词；prey on 指捕食。

ex.en: The lab bought new apparatus for measuring air quality.
ex.zh: 实验室购买了测量空气质量的新仪器。

words.note: apparatus 单复数同形；计量用 a piece of apparatus。

ex.en: He was promoted to lieutenant after three years of service.
ex.zh: 服役三年后，他被提升为中尉。

words.note: 英式发音中 f 音特殊；lieutenant 也可比喻副手。

ex.en: The little boy kept tugging at his mother's sleeve.
ex.zh: 小男孩不停地拽他妈妈的袖子。

words.note: tug at 指反复用力拉；tug 也指拖船。

ex.en: The team set off on an expedition to the Arctic last spring.
ex.zh: 去年春天，这支队伍出发去北极探险。

words.note: expedition 指有组织的考察；expedite 是加快，勿混。

ex.en: Sugar left on the teeth speeds up tooth decay.
ex.zh: 留在牙齿上的糖分会加速蛀牙。

words.note: decay 不及物，指逐渐腐烂衰败；tooth decay 固定。

ex.en: She continues to grieve for her father, who died last winter.
ex.zh: 她仍在为去年冬天去世的父亲悲伤。

words.note: grieve for sb 表为失去的人悲伤；名词是 grief。

ex.en: He was so absorbed in his book that he missed the stop.
ex.zh: 他太专注于看书，结果坐过了站。

words.note: be absorbed in 表全神贯注；absorb 本义吸收。

phr.en: as far as sth is concerned

ex.en: Parents are increasingly concerned about the time children spend online.
ex.zh: 家长们越来越担心孩子上网的时间。

words.note: concerned 表担心的，concerning 表关于，注意区分。

ex.en: The X-ray showed a small fracture in his left wrist.
ex.zh: 爱克斯光片显示他左手腕有一处小骨折。

words.note: fracture 比 break 正式，多用于医学；名词同形。

ex.en: The bank promised to rectify the mistake in my account immediately.
ex.zh: 银行承诺立即纠正我账户上的错误。

words.note: rectify 比 correct 正式，多用于错误、问题。
